SELECT
  product_name,
  brand,
  price_eur
FROM mv_latest_prices
WHERE
  category = 'phone' AND last_price_date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM price_snapshots)
ORDER BY
  price_eur NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1

SELECT
  product_name,
  brand,
  price_eur
FROM mv_latest_prices
WHERE
  category = 'laptop' AND last_price_date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM price_snapshots)
ORDER BY
  price_eur DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1

SELECT
  category,
  COUNT(id) AS product_count
FROM products
GROUP BY
  category
ORDER BY
  category
LIMIT 50

SELECT COUNT(ps.date) FROM price_snapshots ps WHERE ps.date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM price_snapshots)
LIMIT 50

SELECT
  product_name,
  brand,
  drop_eur
FROM vw_biggest_drops
WHERE
  drop_date >= (SELECT MAX(date) FROM price_snapshots) - INTERVAL '7 days'
ORDER BY
  drop_eur ASC
LIMIT 1

WHERE
  p.category = 'laptop' AND vbd.drop_date >= (
    SELECT
      MAX(date)
    FROM price_snapshots
  ) - INTERVAL '7 days'
ORDER BY
  vbd.drop_pct ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT
  product_name,
  brand,
  price_eur
FROM mv_latest_prices
WHERE
  category = 'phone' AND product_name ILIKE '%iPhone 15%' AND price_eur IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
  price_eur NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1

SELECT
  p.product_name,
  p.brand,
  p.model,
  mpf.all_time_low
FROM products AS p
JOIN mv_price_floor AS mpf
  ON p.id = mpf.product_id
WHERE
  p.product_name ILIKE '%Samsung Galaxy S24%' AND p.category = 'phone'
ORDER BY
  mpf.all_time_low ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT
  mv_price_history.product_name,
  mv_price_history.date,
  mv_price_history.price_eur,
  mv_price_history.prev_price,
  mv_price_history.pct_change
FROM mv_price_history
WHERE
  mv_price_history.product_name ILIKE '%Samsung Galaxy S24%'
  AND mv_price_history.date >= (
    SELECT
      MAX(date) - INTERVAL '7 days'
    FROM price_snapshots
  )
ORDER BY
  mv_price_history.date DESC
LIMIT 50

SELECT
  p.product_name,
  p.brand,
  ps.price_eur
FROM products AS p
JOIN price_snapshots AS ps
  ON p.id = ps.product_id
WHERE
  p.category = 'phone' AND p.ram_gb = 16 AND ps.date = (
    SELECT
      MAX(date)
    FROM price_snapshots
  ) AND p.last_seen = (
    SELECT
      MAX(last_seen)
    FROM products
  )
ORDER BY
  ps.price_eur NULLS LAST
LIMIT 50

SELECT 'NO_DATA' AS no_data WHERE false
LIMIT 50
